integrity: Analytic proof of infinite switches and asymptotic spacing, corroborated by a finite reproducible program; independent audit not performed; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_limitations: Single price-taking buyer, unit fixed budget, explicitly oscillatory analytic utility, quadratic generation cost varying over all positive coefficients. Switching thresholds accumulate at zero cost; no finite positive-cost accumulation and no empirical calibration claimed.
title: Infinite budget-binding reversals in a strictly concave analytic electricity market
